svg.title: The parts of a Google Sheets window
svg.desc: A Google Sheets window showing the DSTI ATUS Data Working workbook, with labels for the workbook name, the Name box, the formula bar, a column, a row, the header row, a selected cell (A1), a range (F2:F6) and the sheet tabs.
svg.text: Formula bar: what's really in the selected cell
Sheet tabs: raw, README, log, working
